sentence: In fiscal year 2024, the Business Access Segment retired 4,713 Gold Standard-compliant verified emission reductions (VERs).
note: Sentence copied verbatim from the web page (United Internet Sustainability Report 2024). The segment is named, not the legal entity; United Internet describes its Business Access segment as the business of 1&1 Versatel (annual reports 2014, 2015, 2021, 2023). We therefore look up "1&1 Versatel".
